sources.title: GE2E Loss for Speaker Verification | google/speaker-id | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The GE2E loss provides an efficient training objective for speaker embedding models that produce d-vectors - fixed-dimensional representations of speaker identity. This page covers the conceptual foundation, mathematical formulation, implementation details, and applications of GE2E loss.
